title: Structured Identity Experiment v1 Milestone 1 infrastructure

claims.statement: Milestone 1 infrastructure is implemented without model fitting: canonical ontology/target columns, deterministic grouped outer folds, inner partitions, R0/R1/R2 representation contracts, within-cycle null manifests, tests, and a machine-readable receipt.

The readiness-gated full metadata pass processed 15 sessions, 23042 ontology rows, 9161 eligible trials, 9161 valid outer-fold rows, 454627 inner-partition rows, and 2753 within-cycle null-manifest rows with seed 42 and 20 planned permutations per non-constant analysis target.
claims.receipt: milestone_1_receipt.json output counts, run_scope.full_eligible_corpus=true, command run 2026-08-10

claims.statement: No decoder was fitted and no M2/M3 structured model was trained; the receipt records training_authorized=false and models_trained=[] while the signed specification requires review before training.
claims.receipt: milestone_1_receipt.json scientific_signoff, training_authorized, models_trained, and stop_rule fields

issues: The receipt materializes representation contracts and a tensor-shape smoke check, not real SPK/LFP feature tensors.
This is infrastructure evidence only; it does not update any decoding claim or Figure 04 scientific result.
M2/M3 training and model selection remain unauthorized pending Milestone 1 review.

verification.verdict: Milestone 1 infrastructure complete; stop for tensor/fold/balance/null review before training.

falsifier: This progress receipt is superseded if the signed v1 specification changes, the receipt is regenerated with different fold/null contracts, or a Milestone 1 review rejects the implementation.
